endpoint.scope: explicit account/project; no location required; exact endpoint override respected

request.model: ref types.ResourceRef, spec UpdateCertificateRequest, o types.CallOptions
request.validation: exact caller CDN v3 refs/service/generation/scope/endpoint, source required/enums/pattern/ranges before credentials or HTTP; typed protected values reveal only at wire boundary; ResourceSpec omits read-only properties; PATCH retains source-required name

response.mapping: generated source-bound nested DTOs, exact integers and optional pointers; free strings and unknown extensions protected; provider ref fields ignored; trustworthy returned identities scanned before field decode; existing caller refs retained; foreign identities rejected; no name adoption
response.collections: fixed single provider page with caller MaxItems/MaxPages/cursor bounds; envelope data removed to prevent unbounded duplicate rows; incomplete results retained

errors.logical: model-specific published numeric status codes; zero success, missing status protocol error, unknown code OperationFailed; sanitized errors without provider message
errors.mutation: receipt on every path, not_sent on local errors; accepted HTTP200 does not imply operation readiness; unknown outcomes never replay, exact-ref observation only

wait_semantics: cache ok/failed/in_queue/processing; configuration Completed/Error/Processing only current observed state; certificate presence/absence exact sequence; LetsEncrypt processed/failed/accepted only order processing, not TLS readiness; missing/unknown states remain unknown; config task_id is metadata, never inferred cache task
limitations: Enumerated 19 source operations only; whole service inventory incomplete, coverage ratio null; no live/deployment evidence
